full_prompt_en: A square fantasy fashion photograph shows a pale young woman with closed eyes standing amid a dense shadowy garden of blossoms and drifting pale petals. She occupies the center, her head tilted slightly toward the left, chin raised, and one hand resting across her upper chest. Her dark hair is mostly hidden beneath an elaborate crown made of small roses, pale pink flowers, leaves, and fine branches, with a few loose strands framing the cheek. A high black lace collar encloses her neck. Her fitted dark gown has puffed shoulders and intricate gold-brown embroidered scrollwork across the bodice, sleeves, and chest. The clothing nearly disappears into the surrounding black-green foliage except where metallic thread catches light. On both sides, muted peach, dusty rose, and cream blooms cluster at different depths; some are soft near the lens, while others remain crisp beside her head. Several light butterfly-like petals hover at the upper left and above her crown. The background is a deep teal-black forest wall with no clear horizon or path. Her skin has a cool porcelain glow, especially at the forehead, nose, cheek, and hand, while the flower crown carries scattered delicate highlights. A narrow diffused light from the upper left singles out the face and blossoms, falling quickly into velvety shadow below. The composition holds a still, almost ceremonial figure inside a restless ring of flowers, giving the image lush, melancholy enchantment.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形幻想时尚摄影呈现一位肤色苍白、闭着眼睛的年轻女子，站在花朵密布的暗花园里，四周有浅色花瓣飘动。她在中央，头稍向左倾，下巴抬起，一只手覆在上胸。深发大部分藏在繁复花冠下，花冠由小玫瑰、浅粉花、叶和细枝构成，几缕散发围着面颊。高高的黑蕾丝领围住脖颈。合身深色长裙有蓬起的肩，衣身、袖子和胸前遍布金棕色刺绣卷纹。除金属丝线接光处外，衣服几乎消失在周围黑绿色草木里。两侧，低饱和桃色、灰玫瑰色与奶油色花朵在不同纵深成簇；有些靠镜头显得柔软，另一些在头边仍清晰。几片浅色蝴蝶般花瓣漂在左上和花冠上方。背景是深青黑的林地墙，没有明确地平线或路径。肌肤有冷瓷般微光，额头、鼻梁、面颊和手尤为明显，花冠上也散着细亮点。一道从左上来的窄而漫射的光单独挑出面孔和花朵，往下迅速落入丝绒般暗影。构图把静止、近乎仪式感的人物收在躁动花环中，产生丰盛而忧郁的迷人气息。
style_prompt_en: Fantasy fashion photography uses a narrow soft key light to reveal porcelain-pale focal surfaces and small blooms inside deep teal-black shadow. Layer near and far organic textures densely, letting some foreground petals blur while the central detail stays crisp. Pair intricate metallic embroidery or similarly fine reflective detail with matte dark fabric and velvety foliage. Keep color restrained in dusty rose, cream, muted peach, oxidized green, and black, with highlights scattered sparingly. A compact still focal pose set inside a loose circular drift of ornament creates ceremonial calm and an enchanted, melancholy atmosphere.
style_prompt_zh: 幻想时尚摄影以窄而柔的主光，在深青黑暗影里显出瓷白焦点表面与小花。把近远有机纹理密集叠起，让部分前景花瓣虚化，中央细节仍清楚。精密金属刺绣或类似细反光细节，对着哑光深色布与丝绒般树叶。配色克制在灰玫瑰、奶油色、低饱和桃色、氧化绿和黑色中，高光稀疏散布。紧凑静止的焦点姿态置于松散环状装饰漂动之内，形成仪式般的平静与迷人忧郁气氛。
theme_en: A pale woman crowned with flowers amid a dark blooming garden
theme_zh: 苍白女子戴繁花冠，立于幽暗盛放花园
name: Bella Kotak
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
